title: Swimlanes with active stretches and idle breaks
description:
As a user, I want one lane per session, grouped by project, whose bars show when the session was actually active, so that I can see overlaps and idle time at a glance.

Idle detection has no fixed cutoff: a gap between consecutive messages is idle when it is an outlier among that session's own gaps (Tukey upper fence, Q3 + 1.5 IQR). Sessions with too few gaps to estimate (under 4) are drawn as one stretch. Sessions with no message timestamps are drawn as one started..last-activity span marked "approximate".

```gherkin
Feature: Session swimlanes
  Scenario: Lanes are grouped by project and ordered by start
    Given sessions in projects "alpha" and "beta"
    When the timeline example renders
    Then each project has a labelled group of lanes
    And lanes within a group are ordered by start time

  Scenario: An unusually long gap splits a session into stretches
    Given a session whose messages are a few minutes apart except one gap far longer than the rest
    When the timeline example renders
    Then that session's lane shows two active stretches

  Scenario: A session without message timestamps is approximate
    Given a session with a start and last-activity time but no message timestamps
    When the timeline example renders
    Then its lane shows one span marked approximate
```

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Design change 2026-10-31 after running on real history: a per-session Tukey fence on message gaps cannot separate within-turn, between-turn and away gaps (real Claude Code sessions got about 66 breaks per lane). Activity is now defined by turns instead, with no thresholds: an active stretch runs from a user message to the last agent message before the next user message; the time until the next user message is shown as waiting and is not counted in concurrency. Implemented in BotSpy PR #36.
